text.aria-label: Title text 'The S1 family's q01 and q05 forecasts are wider than needed and its q95 slightly too low; manual_heuristic and climatology miss by more Share of actuals at or below each quantile, mean over clean half-hours, 4 test months. The dashed line is the nominal level, so a dot left of it means too few actuals fell below.'
text.tspan: The S1 family's q01 and q05 forecasts are wider than needed and its q95 slightly too low;
manual_heuristic and climatology miss by more
Share of actuals at or below each quantile, mean over clean half-hours, 4 test months. The dashed line is the
nominal level, so a dot left of it means too few actuals fell below.
